reservoirs.name: Gassum Formation

fault_scenarios.orientation: all supplied traces represented vertically through all six Gassum layers
fault_scenarios.response_method: unit-rate OPM responses superposed for 1, 2 and 3 Mt/yr screening

reservoirs.ensemble_design: L9 perturbations around mapped geology for each all-fault state and Alpha/Beta/Zeta unit response

geological_model.geometry: DECODE EarthVision top Gassum and top Vinding horizons
geological_model.petrophysics_method: porosity from robust well-calibrated mid-reservoir TVDSS depth trend; permeability from paired sand-sample porosity-permeability transform

limitations: Screening proxy only; not a CO2STORE simulation.
Rate scaling is approximately linear and does not resolve multiphase near-well effects.
Fault thresholds and geomechanical coupling are illustrative until calibrated data are supplied.
